name: Nakadashi Oyako ~Manamusume ni Ippai Sosoide Hoshii noo~
original_name: なかだし娘妹 愛娘にいっぱい注いでほしいのぉ
source: A middle-aged teacher and widower named Hanyuu Akira has a relationship with his stepdaughter Hanyuu Ayuka, and decides to stay with her despite opposition from society. When his colleague and sister-in-law Sakaki Mina suspects the relationship, he sleeps with her to protect Ayuka. Later, when Ayuka is hospitalized, Mina moves into Akira's house and begins a relentless pursuit of him.
translation: 中年教师、鳏夫羽生明与继女羽生鲇香发生了关系，不顾社会的反对，决定和她在一起。当他的同事兼嫂子坂木美菜怀疑这段关系时，他为了保护鲇香而与她上床。后来，阿由卡住院后，米娜搬进了阿基拉的家，并开始了对他的无情追求。
